title: Unit Event — Get Over It — Episode8 Our Kind Of Music

meta.Event Outline: After their first solo show, Leo/need get advice about professionalism from anemone's Saku and STANDOUT's Iori. But something they say doesn't sit quite right with Saki...

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! So, they're really gonna sign you to a deal?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
We're meeting this weekend to discuss it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's amazing.
Your dream of going pro might actually come true.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, their solo show did go pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it did.
And it's wonderful to hear such good news.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for dropping by to tell us this, girls.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You shouldn't be thanking us.
We really should be the ones thanking you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's also nearly the weekend, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! My heart won't stop pounding!
I'm already getting kinda nervous about going over to their office!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What should we wear?
Suits?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree that we need to show that we're serious, but suits might be a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It may actually have the opposite effect.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Then, we'll be fine in our regular clothes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, Saki, you seem a lot better now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You felt scared about what was gonna happen after we went pro, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you don't seem bothered by that at all now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It did bother me a little until just recently... But I feel all better now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I figured out a way to deal with my fears like you said, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You already found your answer, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I did!
I mean, I can't straggle behind while the rest of you keep moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... I'm really excited about us going pro now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because we'll probably get to do lots and lots more stuff like Iori and Saku said!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You seem confident, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
Y-You think so?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. The look on your face right now tells me that Leo/need will be able to handle whatever comes its way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
As for your solo show...
It was good, and I'm guessing everyone there was moved by your performance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think that happened because you were being yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Being ourselves...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, during the last song in particular, we sort of just let ourselves go while we played it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I remember noticing that Saki had switched up her sound.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was when I realized how we didn't have to try so hard to sound good. We could just have fun, and that's what makes our music what it is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Once I knew that, things felt so much simpler, and I just had fun singing and playing my guitar...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...
To be honest, we probably weren't as good technically compared to when we played with anemone, but the crowd was really on our side this time around...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Exactly...
Music isn't just about technical mastery.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
The emotions I felt during that song...
You all looked like you were having so much fun while playing it. Again, it was a very moving performance...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It reminded me just how much I love Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, even after you take this next big step, I hope you girls never forget that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Keep up the good work.
We'll always be rooting for you, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This means more and more people might start listening to your music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so exciting...
A few days later
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you very much for inviting us here today. So, regarding our deal...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Haha. There's no need to act so formal. Let's keep things friendly since we're going to be working together from now on.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Together...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As for the details, we'll be going over each part of your contract one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: This is going to feel like a tough slug, so I hope you're all prepared.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Then, once we've gone over all that, you'll be given a chance to discuss it amongst yourselves...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Also, because you're all minors, you'll need to go home and ask your parents or guardians to review it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They'll be more than welcome to contact me directly if they have any outstanding questions regarding this process.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Again, there's quite a lot to go over and it's going to take time to review it all...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But once you sign after confirming that everything is in order, you'll officially be signed to our label as artists.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, shall we begin by reviewing the stipulations laid out in this contract?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
First, I'll give each of you a copy of it.
Here it is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! This font's tiny!
Yeah, it's definitely gonna take a lot of time to go through all this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's full of really important stuff, right? I'll do my best to read as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: U-Um, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Haha. Like I said, feel free to relax.
It'll make my job easier as well.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: More to the point, if you do sign this contract, I will...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll be your main point of contact, so again, let's keep things friendly between us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Once we sign this contract, we'll officially start working as artists for this label.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(We'll have our deal...
Our dream... We'll finally be pros!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I get that a lot of things are gonna happen moving forward... Some fun and some not so fun...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But I'm not hesitating anymore.
And I don't feel scared now. I'm okay...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wanting our music to be heard and wanting to keep playing music with them... Both things matter to me... A lot.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll be fine as long as I don't forget that.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So, I'm gonna keep trying...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Leo/need's gonna keep trying...
To move people's hearts with the music we love!)
